Overview

A major quality upgrade for Virexa.

Virexa 3.5 is a Preview image-generation model focused on substantially higher visual quality, stronger composition, better text rendering, and more convincing people, objects, and natural scenes.

The current Preview supports text input and image output only. It is available in Zorix Chat; public API access and pricing have not been announced.

Provenance

Generated-content markers may be present.

Virexa outputs may contain visible or invisible provenance signals intended to help identify AI-generated content.

Generated content notice

Generated by the Zorix Virexa model. Additional provenance markers, including SynthID and a Zorix watermark, may be present by design to help identify AI-generated content. If a watermark is detected, this is expected.

OpenAI-related marker

An OpenAI-related provenance marker may appear when an additional OpenAI image-processing step is used in the workflow. Its presence alone does not mean the underlying image was originally generated by an OpenAI image model. The image itself can still originate from Virexa.

Illustrative visualization of an invisible or machine-detectable marker.
